Research and innovation
We are at the forefront of pioneering research and technological development, seeking to make advances in physics and astronomy that will shape the future.
Research and innovation
Study
We offer a variety of courses, covering both broad and specialist disciplines within physics and astronomy.
You'll be supported as you explore your choice of single- or multi-disciplinary topics, including theoretical physics, experimental physics and astronomy, and the many significant places where these intersect.
